info.name: PAD Lab 4 - complete team demonstration
info.description: Current Lab 4 deployment (Gateway 28080, Broker 28601, Discovery 28500). FIRST run scripts/lab4-prepare-postman.py and import its PRIVATE environment. Run folders in order. Regenerate fixtures before repeating a collection. All requests assert their expected status. Removed service-only Gateway routes deliberately expect 404. Native gRPC examples: postman/grpc/README.md. Never export real environment credentials into Git.

item.name: 02 gRPC replicas, real load and subscriptions

request.description: Lab 4: user REST enters Gateway; Gateway dispatches through Broker gRPC.

exec: pm.test("All eight services registered with gRPC and topics", () => { const rows = pm.response.json().instances.filter(i => i.healthy && i.lease_valid && !i.removed); ["player","game","exam","world","zombie","resource","base","crafting"].forEach(s => { const replicas = rows.filter(i => i.service === s + "-service"); pm.expect(replicas.length).to.be.at.least(2); replicas.forEach(i => { pm.expect(i.grpc_url).to.be.a("string").and.not.empty; pm.expect(i.topics).to.include("commands." + s); }); }); });
